'''Keith''' (Japanese: '''キクマ''' ''Kikuma'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG095|The Evolutionary War!]]''.

Keith lives on Island B, one of the [[A-B-C Islands]]. He attends school over on Island A. Unlike many on Island B, he prefers {{p|Huntail}} over {{p|Gorebyss}}. Because of this, he had a rivalry with [[Nancy]] from Island C, who prefers Gorebyss.

He and {{ashfr|the group}} joined [[Professor Birch]]'s visits to Islands C and B to discover more about {{p|Clamperl}} and its branched Evolution. After Birch learned that the islands' waters contained [[Deep Sea Scale]] or [[Deep Sea Tooth]] extract, Keith tagged along again. On Island C Nancy located a Deep Sea Tooth and gave it to Keith. Likewise, Keith ended up finding a Deep Sea Scale on Island B and gave it to Nancy, and she used it to evolve her Clamperl into her desired Gorebyss.

When {{TRT}} came by and tried to steal his and Nancy's Pokémon, {{TP|Ash|Grovyle}} freed the Pokémon with {{m|Leaf Blade}}. Afterwards, they worked together to defeat Team Rocket's mecha, sending them blasting off. As a result, Keith and Nancy were finally able to end their rivalry with each other and waved goodbye to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}.
